messages:
lina (partnerships): Quick sync: Datadog + ApexHW joint announcement + live demo on Wednesday. We need an "ops checklist" for observability so the announcer team can reference during the run. Aim for 6-8 quick checks we can confirm in 15m before go-live.

chris (eng-sre): I'll start: 1) Verify OTLP ingestion endpoint configured for demo API key. 2) Trace sampling rule in Datadog set to 1% global but with an override for service:redwood-demo -> 100% for capture window. 3) Log->trace linking via X-Trace-Id propagation.

tanvi (eng-runtime): Runtime items: 4) Ensure spans include `model.name`, `model.variant`, `gpu.device_id`, `batch.size`. 5) Enable cache span metadata: `cache.hit` boolean and `cache.latency_ms`. Also confirm kernel timing spans show up.

harry (obs-liaison): Dashboard + alert items: 6) Import demo dashboard: latency by model (P50/P95), error traces list, throughput (tokens/sec). 7) Create a trace-based monitor: if error_rate > 2% in 5m, page on-call. Keep alert muted during the demo unless we flip to live mode.

chris (eng-sre): Test commands: a) quick smoke: curl -H "X-Request-Id: demo-$(date +%s)" -d '{"model":"small","input":"hi"}' https://demo.redwood.ai/v1/generate b) produce a burst with our loadgen script: scripts/demo_loadgen.sh --rps 30 --duration 300. Make sure the correlating request-id appears in Datadog.

tanvi (eng-runtime): I'll add a protected admin endpoint to toggle tracing rate: POST /admin/tracing {"rate":0.01} (auth via header). Will log the change to a secure audit log.

lina (partnerships): ApexHW will supply a sample GPU telemetry blob (fan/temp/clock) to embed as span attrs. We want to show hardware-level visibility in the demo.

harry (obs-liaison): Quick import note: I'll attach a minimal dashboard JSON to the runbook with placeholders for DD_API_KEY and DD_APP_KEY. Also will prepare 2 screenshots: 1) trace -> flamegraph, 2) dashboard overview.

dd-bot: Datadog note: OTLP ingest confirmed for integration account. For demo onboarding DM @dd-partner-success to request a short-lived API key. Pre-create a trace-based SLO tile if you want to show SLA during the demo.

chris (eng-sre): Pre-demo checklist I'll post here by EOD: endpoints tested, sampling validated, dashboard imported, admin toggle in place, and one captured 60s 100% trace snapshot.

lina (partnerships): Great — owners: @chris validate sampling + smoke scripts, @tanvi add spans + admin toggle, @harry prepare dashboard + screenshots. Let's meet Mon 10am PT for playtest. Thanks all. :party_parrot:
